objective: Back up every file atlas-ai may modify before it is modified, and let the user list backups and restore them safely.
problem: Roadmap features 5 to 10 write to a user's agent configuration. The security principles and the roadmap require a backup before every write and a way to restore, and none exists yet.
scope: internal/backup: backup set format, writer API (Begin, Track, Commit), reading with validation, plan and restore with drift detection
CLI commands: atlas-ai backups, atlas-ai restore [--yes] [--force] <id>
constraints: Never build after changes; verification uses go test and go vet only
Restore refuses files edited after install unless --force (user decision of 2026-11-12)
Every id read from the user or from disk is validated against a strict pattern; manifest paths must be absolute and blob names plain; symlinks and non-regular files are rejected
Backup directories are 0700 and files 0600; the manifest is written atomically
Restore asks before changing anything and aborts on anything but an explicit yes, including end of input
Tests use t.TempDir and a real filesystem; no secrets or machine-specific paths in any file
